description: 1.12.2 backport of Cheaterpaul's Falling Leaves. gently falling, texture-tinted leaf particles below leaf blocks, with wind simulation, conifer needles, land-stick-fade physics, and a punch-leaves burst. 100% client-side.

releases.notes:
## Fixed
- Crash on entering a world with LoliASM or Cleanroom installed, reported by @Romz24 (#2)

1.12.2 backport of [Falling Leaves](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/falling-leaves-forge) by Cheaterpaul.

**New in this build**
- **Seasonal fall rate (Serene Seasons)**, the new `seasonFallRate` setting scales how many leaves fall per season (default: a steady drift in autumn, a sparse trickle in winter). Soft dependency, without Serene Seasons it does nothing and the mod runs unchanged.

**Serene Seasons, fully supported**, leaves also recolour with the season automatically (the particle samples the block's live colour, which Serene Seasons tints), so autumn leaves fall in autumn colours.

**Also includes**, Dynamic Trees support out of the box, a one-time conflict notice when a mod like Weather2 also adds leaf particles, rain-aware fall speed, and water glide.

**Requires** Minecraft 1.12.2 and Forge 14.23.5.2860+. 100% client-side, no mixins, no coremod, joins any server.

Original Forge mod by Cheaterpaul; based on the Fabric mod by Fourmisain, RandomMcSomethin, and BrekiTomasson.

Mod-compatibility update for the 1.12.2 backport of [Falling Leaves](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/falling-leaves-forge) by Cheaterpaul.

**What's new**
- **Serene Seasons support**, falling leaves recolour with the season automatically. The particle samples the block's live colour, which Serene Seasons tints per season, so a leaf that breaks off in autumn falls in autumn colours.
- **Conflict notice**, a one-time in-game message when a mod that also adds leaf/foliage particles is detected (Weather2 / Weather2 Remastered), so you know to disable one if leaves double up. Toggle with `showCompatWarning` in the config.
- **Dynamic Trees**, leaves fall from dynamic trees out of the box.
- **Rain-aware**, leaves fall a little faster under an open, rainy sky.
- **Water-aware**, a leaf that lands on water glides briefly before stopping.

**Requires** Minecraft 1.12.2 and Forge 14.23.5.2860+. 100% client-side, no mixins, no coremod, joins any server.

Original Forge mod by Cheaterpaul; based on the Fabric mod by Fourmisain, RandomMcSomethin, and BrekiTomasson.

1.12.2 backport of [Falling Leaves](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/falling-leaves-forge) by Cheaterpaul.

Gently falling leaf particles below leaf blocks, tinted to match each leaf's texture and biome, blown around by a smooth-noise wind, tumbling as they fall, then landing, sticking, and fading out. Conifers drop needles, punching a leaf knocks a few loose, and modded leaves are picked up automatically.

**Requires** Minecraft 1.12.2 and Forge 14.23.5.2860+. 100% client-side, no mixins, no coremod, no server install.

Drop the jar in your `mods` folder. Configurable in `config/fallingleaves.cfg` or the in-game mod-list config screen.

Original Forge mod by Cheaterpaul; based on the Fabric mod by Fourmisain, RandomMcSomethin, and BrekiTomasson.
